seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Santa Monica Daily Press certified results: Lieu 60.9% (142,982), Brignano (R) 15.3% (35,851), Melissa Toomim (R) 13.1% (30,653). The Daily Bruin reports a Lieu vs Brignano general. The ballot name form for Lieu (for example, with a middle initial) is unverified. No occupation, office, or education facts were found for Brignano. Lieu's office dates, education, and military service were not researched because the web-search budget ran out. Incumbent means the current member for district number 36; Prop 50 redrew the boundaries.
